testcase.name: Should navigate to billing transfer and complete the billing process
Should delete the flag HANDOVER EXEC ALLOWED CLOSED BILLING PERIOD flag in SYSTEM CONFIGS with API

property.name: suiteName
property.value: Billing Refund - Time based on a resource with multiple quantity with different quantity returned US174510

testcase.name: Prereq Should create and set the flag HANDOVER EXEC ALLOWED CLOSED BILLING PERIOD flag in SYSTEM CONFIGS to true with API
Prereq Should create and set the flag HANDOVER ALLOW POST BILLING ACTION flag in SYSTEM CONFIGS to true with API
Prereq Should create a new yard if it doesnt already exist
Prereq Should create a new partner if it doesnt already exist
Prereq Should create a new site if it doesnt already exist
Should create a new equipment multipart which starts to be available from 30 1 days ago but with API
Should create a pricing rule TB calendar days for our resource being valid from 30 days ago
Should create a pricing condition TB DISP being valid from 30 days ago
Should do a stock increase handover with custom quantity being received 30 days ago with API
Working days only Create a new calendar with Sat Sun set to 0h work with API
Should create a new contract being valid from 30 days ago with API
Should add our equipment multipart to the contract with API
Should delete the flag HANDOVER EXEC ALLOWED CLOSED BILLING PERIOD flag in SYSTEM CONFIGS with API

property.name: suiteName
property.value: Billing Refund - Performance based with relative counters US176758

testcase.name: Prereq Should create and set the flag HANDOVER EXEC ALLOWED CLOSED BILLING PERIOD flag in SYSTEM CONFIGS to true with API
Prereq Should create and set the flag HANDOVER ALLOW POST BILLING ACTION flag in SYSTEM CONFIGS to true with API
Prereq Should create a new yard if it doesnt already exist

testcase.name: Prereq Should create a new partner if it doesnt already exist
Prereq Should create a new site if it doesnt already exist
Should create a new equipment and add a fuel counter to it but with API
Should create a pricing rule PB workdays on the equipment with API
Should create a billing condition PB fuel on the equipment with API
Should do a stock increase on the yard for the equipment with API
To avoid holidays test cases Create a new blank calendar with API
Should create a new contract with API
Should add equipment to the contract with API
Should do a provide to site handover with API
Should create all the performance documents needed with API
Should go to Manage Billings and trigger calculation check the conditions applied
